decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of the film 'Yellow Ticket'. The source documents identify two distinct films with this title: a 1931 film directed by Raoul Walsh (D1S1) and a 1918 film directed by William Parke (D2S1). Both are valid answers corresponding to different referents (films) sharing the same name. The original R5 answers correctly identified both directors without contradiction or irrelevance.
